rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: AROcher
Exhibition name: Mon Cheri ™
rows.Origin: Bred by Jack E. Christensen (United States, 1981).
rows.Bloom: Pink, crimson edges, ages to red . Mild, spice fragrance. 35 to 45 petals. Average diameter 5". Large, borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, high-centered to cupped, reflexed bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, armed with thorns / prickles, bushy, spreading, upright. Semi-glossy, medium green, dense, wavy or ruffled foliage.

Height: 31" to 47" (80 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower, garden or specimen. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
